title: Work by thrust
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the work done by the applied force using the horizontal component and displacement.

title: Frictional force magnitude
description: Important: Correctly determines the kinetic friction force, accounting for the increased normal force due to the vertical component of the applied force.

title: Speed at force removal
description: Essential: Correctly applies the work-energy theorem to find the object's speed when the force is removed, using net work during the first 5m.

title: Total work by friction
description: Essential: Correctly states that the total work done by friction equals the negative of the work done by the thrust, bringing the object to rest.

title: Work-energy application
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem correctly for both the acceleration and deceleration phases of the motion.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (Joules, meters, seconds) throughout the calculation.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall: Uses the incorrect angle or sign for work calculations (e.g., uses sin instead of cos for horizontal work).

title: Normal force mistake
description: Pitfall: Omits the vertical component of the applied force when calculating the normal force and frictional force.
